test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
​​​Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the letter-cluster pair that DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b8207baae89f92d470b70cf44a20d7403eb02f1637c086c53bb6a5e03921e51.png] 

Logic followed here is:

The second letter-cluster is formed by increasing the positional value of each letter in the first letter-cluster by 1 (+1).

1) NK − OL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4e53725c4e4dc6c734f8da9a2f9f520619e0c7d92d987aa87ac6494e85e7407.png] 

2) XU − YV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53d566d9e78cf4309f016bfac719a1fed8abf1c74352fe71ffa86a02b0dbd353.png] 

3) DA − DD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81d53b15be5061d3d044a045fd75d77d70bfff0473243d8d6bcf437e23828c26.png] 

4) AX − BY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/25b10f623ff8777fd376fe10fba2c59cb80fa73096d97317cef61203d572eff0.png] 

 

All pairs except 'DA − DD' follow the (+1, +1) increment pattern.

Therefore, the letter-cluster pair that does not belong to the group is **DA − DD**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
